about.title: About me
about.body: I build software so your business gets more customers, earns more, and looks professional online: sites that load fast and turn visits into calls, systems that organize your information so you can decide faster, and automations that save hours of repetitive work every week. You don't have to take my word for it — I measure every result with the same free Google tools anyone can open and check.
